svg.title: Issue 2 — Page 1 — Panel 5: Squad brief — 5° dutch — mission begins
svg.desc: MW 5° dutch. Full squad NOW AWAKE in gutter channel. Sable RISEN to feet facing group, command posture. Wren standing arms crossed impatient. Jink crouching one hand in curls grinning. Thresh on one knee, rifle across thighs, watching skyline. Luma activating medical scanner (blue-violet holo blooming from wrist). Beyond gutter lip: Victorian roofscape (chimneys, telegraph wires, distant factory smoke column). Grey overcast + faint amber gaslight + 5 muted holo glows. SABLE multi-line briefing.

g.text: We get there. We assess. We plan.
(at our scale, an expedition. Move in 30.)
